_comment: Streaming-provider control for the Vijana BaruBaru app (moviebox-tv).
These endpoints rot fast — of 16 providers in a maintained upstream repo,
only two still worked when tested — so the app reads its provider ORDER
and its DISABLED set from here instead of from compiled-in code. Editing
this file disables or re-orders a source for EXISTING installs within an
hour; no app release, no waiting for users to update.
'order'    — failover order, first is tried first. Names not listed keep
their built-in position. Unknown names are ignored.
'disabled' — sources to skip entirely (e.g. one whose site has died).
Everything here is ADVISORY: if this file is missing, unreachable or
malformed the app falls back to its built-in defaults, and a config that
would disable every provider is refused — users can never end up with no
way to play anything because of an edit here.
Valid names: MovieBox, VidNest, Icefy, VixSrc, 4KHDHub
notes: 2026-08-03: all five live. MovieBox first (streaming-sized files, measured smoothest). VidNest + Icefy are adaptive HLS on separate infrastructure. 4KHDHub last — download-oriented rips, least suited to streaming.
